text:
[RFCS.17.2] [RFCS.17.1]'s two columns are columns of the **census tables**, not of this
document. Both tables carry them, for their own rows:

| table | columns |
|---|---|
| `[RFCS.3.1]` | Atom · Field # · Direction · Purpose · **container-legality** · **stream-class** |
| `[RDSC.7.1]` | Atom · Field # · Multiplicity · `module_id` · Concern · **container-legality** · **stream-class**. `stream-class` is `—` for DSC-only atoms; `SchemaDef` / `Slot` are `both` / `structural`, and `[RDSC.7.1]` owns them under the registry gate's first-census-names-it rule |

Both tables carry `data` (`[STYL.5.3.2.1]`), which is each table's only copy.

The two columns state which containers may carry an atom, and what a replayer does
with it.
